info.title: Education ERP API
info.description:
IELTS teaching and self-training platform.

Every request needs the session cookie from `POST /auth/login`, except the ones marked public. Accounts holding a temporary password can only call `/auth/me`, `/auth/password` and `/auth/logout` until they change it (other routes answer 403 with `code: PASSWORD_CHANGE_REQUIRED`).

Dates are ISO-8601 strings in UTC. Rows outside the caller’s scope answer 404, never 403, so their existence is not revealed.
